content.title: Dropbox CFO Timothy Regan to step down
content.summary: File hosting service provider Dropbox said on Wednesday its chief financial officer Timothy Regan will step ​down after five years in the role and will be ‌succeeded by Ross Tennenbaum, a senior executive at tax software company Avalara.  Tennenbaum will join Dropbox as the company ramps up investment in artificial intelligence, including AI-powered tool Dropbox Dash, which connects apps such as Google Workspace and Slack to ⁠help manage files.  His appointment ‌as Dropbox CFO takes effect on December 16, the company said.
